validation_policy: fixed 256 development windows; final holdout evaluated only after final model selection
primary_comparison: last common evaluated optimizer step across all four variants within each seed; report mean/std across all three seeds
time_budget_comparison: best development score within equal four-hour slots, reported separately

hypotheses.temporal: masked temporal decoder refinement improves within-window dynamics

checkpoint_policy: full resume state periodically; immutable inference checkpoints at each evaluation
ownership: stop only the two earlier project training tasks once the new campaign passes preflight; preserve their artifacts
